Data on this device was erased.
RavanGo is built to work on your device first. Your scripts, recordings and edits belong to you. We don\'t show ads, we don\'t sell data and we don\'t track you across apps.

Without an account: nothing leaves your device. With an account: your email or phone number, an optional display name, and the data you choose to sync. Purchases are handled by the app store; we only receive a purchase token to verify your plan.

Camera recording, face tracking for beauty and makeup, audio processing (noise reduction, levels), the teleprompter, silence detection and video editing all run on your phone. Camera frames and face data are never uploaded or stored.

Cloud sync is off until you turn it on. When enabled, your scripts, folders, presets and settings (and, with Pro, projects, drafts and optionally videos) are stored in your private space, protected so that only your account can read it. Turning sync off stops uploads; deleting your account erases the cloud copy.

AI tools only run after you allow cloud AI processing. The text or audio needed for the task is sent to the provider you selected (the RavanGo AI service or your own key) and the result is returned to you. We don\'t keep your content after the request and don\'t use it to train models.
Payments are processed by the app store. We never see your card details.
RavanGo contains no advertising SDKs. Anonymous statistics and crash reports are sent only if you turn them on above.
You can export your data, erase it from this device, or delete your account and all cloud data at any time from this screen. For any question, contact support.
Sign-in tokens and your own API keys are encrypted with the Android Keystore. All network traffic uses HTTPS.
RavanGo isn\'t directed at children under 13 and doesn\'t knowingly collect their data.
If this policy changes in a meaningful way, we\'ll tell you in the app before the change applies.
By using RavanGo you agree to these terms. If you don\'t agree, please don\'t use the app.
An account is optional. If you create one, keep your sign-in details safe; you\'re responsible for activity on your account.
You own everything you create. You give us only the permission needed to store and sync it for you when you enable cloud features.
AI-generated text, captions and edit suggestions may be inaccurate. Review them before publishing.

RavanGo Pro is billed monthly or yearly through the app store and renews automatically until cancelled. The yearly plan may include a free trial; if you don\'t cancel at least 24 hours before it ends, the yearly price is charged. Manage or cancel anytime in your store account; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period. Lifetime is a one-time purchase of all Pro features with the monthly AI allowance and backup storage stated at purchase. Refunds follow the store\'s policy.

Each plan includes monthly AI credits that reset at the start of each month and don\'t roll over. Purchased credit packs don\'t expire and are used after the monthly allowance. Credits have no cash value.
Don\'t use RavanGo to create unlawful content, infringe others\' rights, or abuse the service (for example by automating AI requests).
RavanGo is provided \"as is\". Keep backups of important recordings. To the extent permitted by law, we\'re not liable for lost data or indirect damages.
We may update these terms; we\'ll let you know in the app before significant changes take effect.
